description: Labeled live-eval cases for Bedrock complaint classification. Text lives in-repo; images are referenced externally (S3 object keys or HTTPS URLs) and are never committed as binaries.

imageSource.notes: Resolve imageRef against CLASSIFICATION_EVAL_S3_PREFIX in S3 (bucket defaults to AWS_S3_BUCKET), or against CLASSIFICATION_EVAL_IMAGE_BASE_URL for HTTPS hosts. Absolute imageUrl bypasses env base settings.

cases.description: Huge pothole on Bliss Street near AUB main gate, cars keep swerving and traffic is backing up.
Overflowing garbage bins blocking the sidewalk near Mar Elias school, strong odor since yesterday.
Street light in front of building 24 on Rue Gouraud has been dark for three nights.
Water is leaking from a broken pipe near the pharmacy in Verdun and covering the road.
Construction noise is extremely loud after midnight near Sassine Square and residents cannot sleep.
Sidewalk tiles are broken and lifted near Hamra Main Street; a walker almost tripped.
Traffic light at the Adlieh intersection has been stuck on red since morning.
Storm drain on Airport Road is blocked; after rain the street floods and water reaches nearby shops.
The public bench in Sanayeh garden is broken with sharp screws sticking out.
Can you tell me if there is a concert on the waterfront this weekend and what ticket prices are?
There is a problem near my house.
My apartment kitchen sink is clogged and the landlord will not fix it.
